title: Origin story: Isis
description: Isis was the wife and sister of Osiris, the greatest magician among gods. When Set murdered Osiris and scattered his body, Isis gathered the pieces across Egypt, reassembled him with her spells, and conceived Horus. She then hid the child in the marshes and raised him to avenge his father.
